dataset: CBAM goods by CN code: EU default values for Egypt and EU imports from Egypt

markup_schedule.rule: The mark-up is applied to the default value in the column 'total emissions'; the final figure with mark-up is calculated in the CBAM Registry.

route_codes.(F): Low alloy Steel based on BF/BOF
route_codes.(G): Low alloy Steel based on DRI/EAF
route_codes.(H): Low alloy Steel based on scrap/EAF

route_note: Each country has one default value per code; the default does not change with the plant's route. The route indicator in the default table fixes which CBAM benchmark (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2620) is used for the free allocation deduction when the importer declares on default values. '(C)/(F)' means carbon steel (C) or low alloy steel (F), by the grade. Where no indicator is given, the benchmark does not depend on the route.
egypt_exports_flag_rule: egypt_exports_2025 is true when Comext records EU imports from Egypt above EUR 0 for that code in 2025; some lines are very small (for example 7203, EUR 858). TARIC lines are false because Comext does not publish the TARIC split.
units: Default values in tCO2e per tonne of good (electricity: tCO2e per MWh). Trade: EUR and tonnes (Comext quantity in 100 kg divided by 10, rounded).
